tables.name: Weather
tables.description: The weather when the adventurers arrive. Roll again whenever it should change.

results.name: Good
results.description: Unseasonably excellent. A warm day in winter, a cool day in summer, etc.

results.name: Mild
results.description: The best kind of day that could be expected for the season. Rain or snow is light, if at all. Winds are soft.

results.name: Fair
results.description: A normal day for the season. Rain, snow or wind are average and manageable.

results.name: Harsh
results.description: A rough day for the season. Rain, snow and wind are strong and could make things difficult.

results.name: Bad
results.description: Most folk are staying indoors. Travel is dangerous in these conditions. Rain is torrential, snow is blinding. Winds potentially reach hurricane force.
